t: The Smith & Locke 150mm gate bolt provides reliable access control for small to medium gates, sheds and outbuildings. Built from zinc alloy with a durable black coated finish, it resists rust and wear in outdoor environments. The key-operated 5-pin locking mechanism delivers increased security over standard bolts, helping deter tampering and forced entry. Supplied with fixings for straightforward installation on timber gates and frames, it is a practical choice for residential and light trade applications.
b: 150mm Length For Small to Mid-Size Gates
